apps.name: JSRF Unleashed
apps.subtitle: Jet Set Radio Future, natively
apps.localizedDescription:
Jet Set Radio Future, statically recompiled: the game's own code translated to native code and running on Metal -- not an emulator.

Bring your own game: the USA release of Jet Set Radio Future. After installing, open the app once, then copy the game into its folder in the Files app (On My iPhone > JSRF Unleashed): either the extracted folder with default.xbe in it, or the disc image (.iso), which the app unpacks itself.

A controller is the best way to play (Xbox, PlayStation, MFi and others); without one there are on-screen controls. Widescreen 16:9; saves are kept in the game's folder.

Experimental: plays on iPhone, but far less played than the Mac build. Bug reports with the log from the app's Logs folder are welcome on GitHub.

versions.localizedDescription: First iPhone and iPad release (experimental): the Metal renderer, on-screen controls, controllers and keyboards, the game copied in through the Files app or unpacked from a disc image.
